title: Analista de relações com investidores e esg iii
description:
Descrição da vaga
A Helbor Empreendimentos S. A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado da B3, a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.
A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.
Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia. Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e Power Point em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal. Informações adicionais
O que nós oferecemos:
Vale Alimentação
Vale Refeição
Assistência Médica
Assistência odontológica
Participação nos Resultados

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing
Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations:
Language Requirement: Fluent English
Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate: $60.00
Minimum Hours: No minimum
Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability
About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Sap technical lead
description:
About SEW
Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and Io T-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.

420+ global clients across the U. S., Europe, Canada, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific
1,550+ employees and growing rapidly
Millions of users engaged monthly
150+ industry awards and global recognition from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, and LA Times Searching for your dream job? Summary
We are seeking a Senior SAP Technical Leader with deep expertise across SAP's core and cloud platforms to design and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for utility enterprises.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP solutions across S/4 HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Service Cloud V2, and SAP IS-U
Architect clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility using ABAP, OData, RAP, and SAP-recommended extension frameworks

Optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability across the SAP landscape
Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions Required Qualifications
Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
Strong expertise in OData services, REST APIs, and SAP integration patterns
Proven experience implementing clean core–compliant extensibility
Deep knowledge of SAP IS-U in utility enterprise environments
Experience with SAP Service Cloud V2 and SAP CX integrations
Solid understanding of SAP BTP, including extension, integration, and API management services
Strong background in system integration, performance tuning, and scalability
Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions
Utility industry experience
Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory

title: Data engineer - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:We're looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you'll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.
Develop, schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks. What we are looking for:
A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models...
Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment. What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our " Get Together" where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)

Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion) Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of marketing
Progress: every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture: join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship: you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won't give up until we make a huge dent in this industry! Come join us!

Requisitos adicionais, como cursos voltados à área odontológica, serão considerados diferenciais.

title: Representante técnico de vendas
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.
Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.
Atividades:
●Gestão de Relacionamento: Realizar o planejamento estratégico de visitas via CRM, garantindo a execução rigorosa das rotas e o cumprimento das metas de atendimento.
●Expansão de Mercado: Gerir e prospectar carteiras de clientes de forma ativa, identificando novas oportunidades de negócio na região.
●Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: Ministrar treinamentos técnicos e prestar assistência especializada tanto para canais de distribuição quanto para o cliente final.
●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações.
●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca.
Requisitos e qualificações:
●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia.
●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região.
●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal.
●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

title: Social seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digitalVocê é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?
Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?
Então essa vaga é para você. Sobre a Red Suit
Na Red Suit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.
Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time. O que faz um Social Seller?
O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, Linked In e outros canais).
Na prática, você atuará como um "clone digital" do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes. Responsabilidades Principais
Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia O que esperamos de você
Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular) O que oferecemosSalário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)
Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas
Acesso a mentorias exclusivas e conteúdos avançados
Trabalho 100% remoto, com flexibilidade de horários
Contrato PJ com possibilidade real de crescimento acelerado Nossa cultura
Aqui, valorizamos:
Alta performance com meritocracia verdadeira
Aprendizado contínuo e evolução constante
Ambiente colaborativo, leve e orientado a resultados
Pessoas que jogam para ganhar e crescem junto com a operação Cada venda representa transformação real , para o cliente, para o expert e para a sua carreira. Pronto para crescer no digital?
Se você tem mentalidade vencedora e quer se destacar em um dos mercados que mais crescem no mundo, essa é a sua oportunidade.
Candidate-se agora e venha fazer parte do nosso time de alta performance.

title: Site reliability engineer
description:
Company Overview: Lean Tech is a rapidly expanding organization situated in Medellín, Colombia. We pride ourselves on possessing one of the most influential networks within software development and IT services for the entertainment, financial, and logistics sectors. Our corporate projections offer a multitude of opportunities for professionals to elevate their careers and experience substantial growth. Joining our team means engaging with expansive engineering teams across Latin America and the United States, contributing to cutting-edge developments in multiple industries.Position Title: Mid+ Site Reliability Engineer Location: Remote - LATAMWhat you will be doing: We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to drive reliability, scalability, and operational excellence across our Saa S platform. This role is critical in improving incident response, system observability, and performance optimization, while proactively preventing disruptions. As part of the Cloud Operations organization, you will lead post-incident investigations, implement preventative strategies, and partner with Engineering and Observability teams to enhance system resilience. You will also play a key role in building automation, improving time-to-resolution (TTR), and enabling a data-driven approach to reliability.Requirements & Qualifications To excel in this role, you should possess:
Strong expertise in SRE practices, incident management, and production operations.
Hands-on experience with observability tools such as:
New Relic
Datadog
Sumo Logic
or similar platforms
Proficiency in programming/scripting (e.g., Java Script,. NET, SQL).
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure acceptable).
Strong understanding of Saa S architectures and distributed systems.Experience troubleshooting C#/. NET web applications and performance issues. Nice to Have:Experience with:
CI/CD pipelines
Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Formation)
Strong troubleshooting experience in:
Windows environments
SQL Server
Previous experience as a:
Software Engineer
System Administrator Soft Skills:
Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams. Why you will love Lean Tech:
Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
Professional development opportunities with international customers
Collaborative work environment
Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Full-stack developer
description:
Join one of the most exciting early-stage platforms as we scale our engineering team globally.
You'll be building on your full-stack experience, evolving a platform that balances cutting-edge tech with real-world stability. We are looking for a pragmatic \"builder\" who is comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and can take a feature from a raw idea to a polished delivery.
This is a 100% remote contract role (PJ) for a developer based in Brazil, reporting to our US/UK-based leadership. You'll be central to our product delivery, working across the entire stack to ensure our users have a seamless, reliable experience.
Some of your day-to-day will be:
Full-Stack Development: Owning features from end-to-end using Type Script and React.
Backend & Data: Building and maintaining robust services with Postgres and integrating third-party APIs.
Product Evolution: Supporting ongoing feature delivery and improving stability across key user flows.
Code Quality: Contributing to a maintainable codebase as the platform grows, balancing speed with long-term reliability.
Smart Engineering: Utilizing modern tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery without losing sight of fundamental coding principles. Requirements:
Mid-to-Senior Experience: Strong background in Java Script/Type Script and modern frontend frameworks (React).
Database Fluency: Proven experience with relational databases (Postgres or similar).
Startup Mindset: Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment where requirements evolve.
Independent Operator: Able to take ownership of tasks and work autonomously to hit delivery goals.
Communicator: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to collaborate with our international team.
Pragmatic: A focus on \"what works\" and \"what scales,\" avoiding over-engineering where it isn't needed. Benefits:
International Contract (PJ): Competitive remuneration.
100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil.
Direct Impact: Work directly with the founding team; no layers of middle management.
Modern Stack: Access to the latest development tools and a clean, high-velocity environment.
Growth: Opportunity to grow alongside the platform as we scale.

title: Portuguese transcriptionist
description:
Job Title: Urgent: Brazilian Portuguese Audio Transcription Specialist (2-Hour Paid Trial)
About the Project: We at Thoth AI are looking for language specialists based in Brazil to join a short-term audio transcription and labeling project for AI training (ASR/TTS). This project kicks off with a 2-hour paid trial this Tuesday or Wednesday.
Requirements:
Target Language & Location: First-language proficiency (C2 level) in Brazilian Portuguese, currently based in Brazil. You must have a deep understanding of local idioms, accents, and cultural nuances.
English Proficiency: Strong reading comprehension in English is mandatory. You must be able to accurately read, understand, and strictly follow our complex English project policies and guidelines.
Experience: Proven hands-on experience in ASR (Speech Recognition), TTS (Text-to-Speech), or linguistic data labeling projects.
Technical Skills: Proficient in using Adobe Audition for audio processing, cleaning, and editing.
Availability: Must have at least 2 hours of availability this Tuesday (March 31) or Wednesday (April 1) to complete the trial task. What We Offer:
Paid Trial: If your CV passes our initial screening, you will be compensated for the 2-hour trial task upon completion.
Long-term Potential: Successful candidates may be invited to join our ongoing, large-scale linguistic projects. How to Apply: Please send your CV, highlighting your Brazilian Portuguese proficiency, your English comprehension skills, and your previous experience with Adobe Audition. We are screening on a rolling basis—apply now!

title: Advocate art open call for illustrators
description:
Advocate Art is a leader international illustration agency, with over 30 years of experience specialising in publishing, advertising and licensing art.
We call our ethos four " F. A. C. T.s": Fairness, Ability, Creativity and Trust. It's about doing the right thing and being with the right people.
We are looking for freelance illustrators to join our roster of represented artists. This is a fully remote role, enabling you to work from anywhere in the world while building your global reputation as an illustrator.
As a represented illustrator, your agent will work closely with you to secure freelance projects from top-notch clients internationally. Our clientele includes: Scholastic, Harper Collins, Hachette, Oxford University Press, Capstone, American Greetings, Hallmark Cards and Books and many more.
The best part is, we want to see your work, so there's absolutely no cost associated with your submission.
All submissions are processed by our talent scouts at ITSme, and reviewed in conjunction with our Advocate agents.
In order to submit your work, please send a collection of images or a link to your online portfolio/ website to along with some information about you. We will review this and get back to you if you are the right fit to become represented by Advocate.
To find out more about ITSme and our submission process, please visit:

title: Staff machine learning engineer | data science
description:
Descrição da vaga
Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.
Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.
Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.
No dia a dia você vai:
Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos E o que você precisa ter?
Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning Diferenciais:
Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:
No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.
Benefícios:
Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Previdência Privada;
Benefícios flexíveis que se adaptam às suas necessidades;
Auxílio alimentação;
Aconselhamento financeiro;
Clube de vantagens;
Auxílio Home Office;
Auxílio Mobilidade;
Auxílio Criança;
Seguro de Vida;
Licenças estendidas;
Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar;
Empréstimo consignado com taxas reduzidas.

title: Financial advisor
description:
A IBBRA Full Family Office é uma consultoria patrimonial 360o. Nosso propósito é ser para as famílias Brasileiras, um agente de mudança cultural em torno do patrimônio, fomentando emancipação e a realização de objetivos
Buscamos para nossa equipe pessoas dispostas a mudar a cultura patrimonial das famílias brasileiras enquanto se desenvolvem, estruram-se e alcançam novos horizontes.
O executivo de vendas irá atuar no desenvolvimento e gestão da carteira de clientes de alto patrimônio, conduzindo o relacionamento comercial, identificando oportunidades de negócio e assegurando uma experiência consultiva e integrada ao longo de toda a jornada comercial do cliente.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
Gerenciar o relacionamento com o cliente, sendo o principal contato e conselheiro de confiança, prestando consultoria em disponibilidade total e permanente à família atendida.
Atuar de forma consultiva, estratégica e contínua na jornada patrimonial
Atrair, desenvolver e gerir carteira de clientes de alta renda, com foco em crescimento e retenção
Implementar e monitorar estratégias de planejamento patrimonial abrangentes (investimentos, sucessão, proteção e gestão orçamentária), assegurando aderência aos objetivos familiares
Supervisionar carteiras de investimentos e a evolução patrimonial, propondo ajustes conforme perfil de risco e cenário econômico
Conduzir análises financeiras aprofundadas para otimização e alavancagem patrimonial
Coordenar ações multidisciplinares com advogados, contadores e outros especialistas
Coletar e analisar dados financeiros e contextuais, gerando inteligência para tomada de decisão
Promover educação financeira e apoiar a autonomia dos clientes e suas famílias
Atuar com postura ética, fiduciária e independente, em conformidade com as regulamentações Requisitos e Qualificações:
Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas
Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e/ou mercado financeiro
Habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento
Certificação CPA (mínimo) ou em andamento
Diferencial: Certificações CFP, CEA, Ancord, PQO
Diferencial: Inglês intermediário ou avançado O que oferecemos?
Ambiente colaborativo, com oportunidade real de crescimento profissional;
Treinamentos e acompanhamento para desenvolvimento das suas habilidades;
Incentivo intelectual. Informações da vaga:

title: Senior asterisk specialist / latam
description:
DescriptionWe are looking for a highly experienced Asterisk Specialist to join our Level 3 technical support team. This role combines deep hands-on development, tactical guidance, and partner engagement across our technical team. You will be the go-to expert for complex Asterisk core system troubleshooting and custom telephony solutions, working directly with customers and resellers while supporting our internal development teams. This role focuses on Asterisk's underlying engine, custom dialplan development, and advanced Vo IP implementations
English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:
A1 Beginner
A2 Elementary
B1 Intermediate
B2 Upper-Intermediate
C1 Advanced
C2 Proficient Responsibilities
Diagnose and resolve complex Asterisk configuration file and dialplan issues.
Troubleshoot core Asterisk functionality, channel drivers, and application problems.
Elevate telephony engineering skills across our team through mentorship, collaboration, and exemplification.
Support development teams with Asterisk AGI, AMI, and ARI integrations.
Assist with custom Asterisk builds, patches, and telephony application development.
Collaborate closely with technical teams across the enterprise to help transform complex telephony data into actionable insights.
Debug complex dialplan logic and custom Asterisk applications using full logs and real-time traces.
Optimize Asterisk performance, memory usage, and concurrent call handling for high-performance architecture.
Create and maintain detailed documentation for Asterisk configuration patterns and troubleshooting procedures.
Establish team coding standards and best practices for dialplan programming and API integration.
Participate in our on-call schedule to help ensure availability of critical Asterisk core system services.
Provide advanced technical guidance to customers and resellers on custom Asterisk implementations. Requirements
8+ years of experience in engineering, including senior or lead experience in telephony environments.
3+ years of hands-on experience specifically with Asterisk configuration file management and dialplan development.
Deep expertise in Asterisk internals, including dialplan programming, channel configuration, and application development.
Advanced Vo IP knowledge, covering SIP protocol internals, RTP, codec negotiation, and NAT handling.
Strong experience with Linux system administration and command-line expertise.
Proficiency in Asterisk debugging using CLI commands, logging levels, and protocol analysis.
Experience with custom development, specifically AGI scripts, custom applications, and API integrations.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) and working within AWS cloud infrastructure services.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex telephony concepts to non-technical audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred qualifications include Asterisk module development in C, scripting expertise (Python, Perl, PHP), and database integration (Realtime, CDR)

title: Full stack developer
description:
Company Description
Token Flow is an onchain token clarity platform. A B2 B product, giving protocols complete visibility of their token ecosystem, including: all holder addresses, all transactions and their types, market maker tracking and performance, De Fi positions, and much more.
We're a small, lean team with lots of experience in crypto and tokenomics. We've received funding, and we're looking for our first non-founder hire.
What You'll Do
Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs
Architect, deploy, and operate cloud-native systems on GCP, AWS, or Azure, optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability
Own Dev Ops workflows end-to-end — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Pulumi), container orchestration, and environment management
Build, operate, and optimize data ingestion and processing pipelines for high-volume, event-driven workloads
Integrate and manage RPC-based data sources, designing resilient systems for rate-limited, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data access
Design, query, and optimize relational databases, with a strong focus on data modeling, indexing, query performance, and schema evolution
Monitor and maintain system health — defining SLOs, setting up alerting, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks across services and databases
Apply security best practices across services — authentication, authorization, secrets management, input validation, and safe handling of sensitive data
Secure APIs and services against common vulnerabilities — injection, broken auth, and unauthorized access
Enforce HTTPS and encryption for data in transit and at rest, and apply least-privilege access across services and infrastructure
Run security checks in CI/CD pipelines, maintain audit logs for sensitive operations, and set up rate limiting to protect against abuse
Maintain a workflow, continuously identify risks, review access controls, patch vulnerabilities, and improve defenses as systems evolve
Integrate and secure crypto wallet flows in production — signing, transaction validation, and key management
Collaborate across product, data, and infrastructure to ship features end-to-end
Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code Requirements
Previous experience in fullstack, backend-focused software engineering, security engineering, or crypto/web3 development
Strong experience building backend services and APIs
Solid understanding of relational databases, query optimization, and schema design for performance at scale
Experience with Dev Ops practices including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with cloud security fundamentals — secrets management, IAM, network policies, and secure API design
Experience securing API routes and endpoints — proper auth middleware, route guards, role-based access control, and scoped permissions
Understanding of how to handle sensitive data — PII, tokens, credentials — including encryption at rest, masking in logs, and secure storage practices
Experience running and debugging production systems
Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks
Hands-on experience running and maintaining containerized workloads in cloud environments Nice to Have
Experience hardening production systems, database access controls, audit logging, and vulnerability scanning in CI pipelines
Familiarity with the crypto industry, including core blockchain concepts and onchain data
Experience with data-focused platforms (e.g. Dune Analytics, The Graph) and production-grade RPC node integration and monitoring Salary: $36,000 - $42,000 USD
Fully remote, with preference if based in Brazil.

title: Salesforce software engineer
description:
We are hiring experienced Software Engineers to join our team and build on the Salesforce platform. These are hands-on engineering roles — you will be writing code, designing solutions, and shipping features across a large, mature codebase. We are not looking for administrators or declarative-only builders; we need engineers who think in code and architecture.
We're hiring across both UI/Frontend and Backend/Platform specializations, and you'll work on a production Experience Cloud site built with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Bootstrap, supported by a robust backend of Apex services, integrations, and asynchronous processing.
What You'll Work On
Frontend / UI Engineers will focus on:
Building and maintaining Lightning Web Components within an Experience Cloud site serving external users
Working with Bootstrap-based styling and responsive layouts alongside the LWC framework
Designing component architectures that are performant, accessible, and maintainable at scale
Integrating frontend components with Apex controllers, platform events, and real-time data flows Backend / Platform Engineers will focus on:
Designing and building Apex services, triggers, and automation across a complex data model
Implementing and maintaining asynchronous processing patterns including Queueable Apex, Batchable Apex, and Platform Events
Working with the Connect API and other Salesforce platform APIs
Building and supporting Mule Soft integrations for document processing and connectivity to external systems
Ensuring governor limit compliance, bulkification, and performance optimization across high-volume operations All engineers will contribute to code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline— we value a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and software engineering principles
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a meaningful portion spent writing code on the Salesforce platform (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Visualforce)
Demonstrated experience building large-scale applications — you've worked in codebases with significant complexity, not just small apps or proof-of-concept projects
Experience building cloud-native or cloud-hosted applications — you understand multi-tenant architecture, API-driven design, and the tradeoffs of building on a managed platform
Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) — you actively use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review, and you understand how to validate and guide AI-generated output effectively
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), testing strategies, CI/CD, separation of concerns, and clean code practices Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud (Community Cloud) site development
Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC) in production
Experience with Mule Soft (Anypoint Platform, API-led connectivity, Cloud Hub)
Familiarity with Platform Events and event-driven architecture on Salesforce
Experience with Batchable and Queueable Apex patterns for high-volume data processing
Working knowledge of the Salesforce Connect API
Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II (valued but not required — we care more about what you can build than what you've passed)
Experience with Bootstrap or similar CSS frameworks in the context of LWC development
Familiarity with document processing pipelines and integration patterns

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.
O foco principal é no frontend — React, Next.js, performance, arquitetura de componentes, boas práticas. PHP existe na stack, mas a prioridade aqui é quem domina o mundo JS/TS moderno.
O que você vai fazer
→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário
O que esperamos
→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)
→ Capacidade de liderar e fazer code review com autoridade técnica no frontend
→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código
→ Experiência com Type Script, boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito
→ Experiência em estruturar processos em times sem metodologia definida
→ Comunicação clara e maturidade pra dar feedbacks difíceis
Remuneração: A combinar
100% Remoto
---
ATENÇÃO — Como se candidatar
Não aceitamos candidaturas por aqui.
As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.
Candidate-se agora:
Leva cerca de 15 minutos. Você sabe na hora se avança.
---

title: Business process analyst i
description:

1. Design e Documentação de Processos GTM
Documentar e aprimorar os principais processos de execução de GTM (Go-To-Market), incluindo:
Transferência de leads e demanda
Fluxo de oportunidades e negociações
Adoção, renovações e estratégias de expansão
Definir claramente responsabilidades, transições entre equipes e expectativas em cada etapa
Identificar lacunas de execução, pontos de atrito e inconsistências

Criar visualizações simples ou dashboards para identificar problemas e riscos na execução
Usar insights para recomendar melhorias específicas nos processos 3. Colaboração Multifuncional

Registrar decisões e transformá-las em documentação clara
Apoiar iniciativas das equipes com análises estruturadas e acompanhamento contínuo

title: Sap technical lead
description:
About SEW
Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and Io T-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.
Quick Highlights:
420+ global clients across the U. S., Europe, Canada, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific
1,550+ employees and growing rapidly
Millions of users engaged monthly
150+ industry awards and global recognition from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, and LA Times Searching for your dream job? We are a true global company that values building meaningful relationships and maintaining an enthusiastic work environment while fostering innovation and creativity. At SEW, we believe that everyone contributes to our success, and in return, we provide opportunities for them to learn new skills and build a rewarding professional career.
Summary
We are seeking a Senior SAP Technical Leader with deep expertise across SAP's core and cloud platforms to design and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for utility enterprises.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP solutions across S/4 HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Service Cloud V2, and SAP IS-U
Architect clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility using ABAP, OData, RAP, and SAP-recommended extension frameworks
Define and execute integration strategies across SAP and non-SAP systems (APIs, events, middleware)
Design scalable, high-performance architectures that support enterprise and utility-specific requirements
Serve as the technical point of contact for complex initiatives, guiding development teams and solution partners
Ensure solutions align with SAP best practices, security standards, and long-term platform roadmaps
Optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability across the SAP landscape
Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions Required Qualifications
Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
Strong expertise in OData services, REST APIs, and SAP integration patterns
Proven experience implementing clean core–compliant extensibility
Deep knowledge of SAP IS-U in utility enterprise environments
Experience with SAP Service Cloud V2 and SAP CX integrations
Solid understanding of SAP BTP, including extension, integration, and API management services
Strong background in system integration, performance tuning, and scalability
Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions
Utility industry experience
Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory
Fluency in Spanish is highly required \"SEW is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.\"

title: Bizdev & parcerias
description:
Venha fazer parte da Velana
Estamos em busca de um(a) Biz Dev & Parcerias Estratégicas com forte experiência no ecossistema de meios de pagamento e gateways, perfil estratégico e grande capacidade de relacionamento. Essa posição é focada no desenvolvimento de novos negócios e construção de parcerias estratégicas dentro do mercado de pagamentos digitais, com atuação voltada à expansão da Velana através de integrações, plataformas, e-commerces e parceiros do ecossistema. Buscamos alguém que já tenha vivência com gateways de pagamento, compreenda a dinâmica do mercado e consiga identificar oportunidades de crescimento através de conexões estratégicas.
Sobre a Velana
A Velana é um gateway de pagamentos digital em crescimento acelerado, conectando e-commerces, plataformas e infoprodutores a soluções de pagamento seguras e eficientes. Nossa expansão passa por tecnologia, estratégia comercial e desenvolvimento de parcerias relevantes.
Principais Responsabilidades
Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio no mercado de meios de pagamento;
Prospectar e-commerces, plataformas digitais, infoprodutores e parceiros estratégicos para integração com o gateway Velana;
Desenvolver e estruturar parcerias estratégicas com plataformas, agências, comunidades e soluções do ecossistema digital;
Atuar de forma consultiva apresentando soluções de gateway de pagamento, adquirência e processamento;
Identificar oportunidades de integração com plataformas e sistemas que utilizem ou demandem soluções de pagamento;
Analisar mercado, concorrência e tendências dentro do setor de pagamentos digitais e fintechs;
Gerar oportunidades qualificadas para o time comercial;
Registrar e acompanhar oportunidades no CRM;
Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de Vendas, Produto e Marketing para fortalecer a estratégia de expansão. Requisitos Essenciais
Experiência comprovada com gateways de pagamento, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
Vivência no ecossistema de fintechs, e-commerce, plataformas digitais ou Saa S;
Experiência em Business Development, parcerias estratégicas ou desenvolvimento de negócios;
Forte capacidade de relacionamento e construção de networking estratégico;
Boa comunicação e habilidade de negociação com decisores (CEOs, Founders, Heads);
Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a oportunidades.
Networking dentro do ecossistema de plataformas, produtores digitais e e-commerces;
Conhecimento em integrações de pagamento, APIs ou soluções financeiras digitais. O que Oferecemos
• Autonomia para estruturar e testar estratégias de desenvolvimento de negócios;
• Atuação direta no coração da operação da Velana;
• Ambiente ágil, colaborativo e sem burocracia;
• Contratação PJ | 100% remoto;

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Wordpress plugin & full stack developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.
Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?
Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.
About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.
Responsibilities
Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
Test Planning and Execution: Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality.
Defect Management: Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
Collaboration: Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality.
Automation: Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks.
Quality Standards: Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. Qualifications
Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines. Compensation
Salary: based on your experience level
To Apply Submit:
Current resume
Synopsis of recent salary history
If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview Requirements Before Employment
Signed Confidentiality agreement
Signed Non-compete agreement
Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form Company Culture
Remote
We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
Hours 8 AM - 5 PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

title: Ugc content creator (freelance)
description:
About the Company
We are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.
Role Overview
Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for Tik Tok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.
Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.
Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.
Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.
Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.
Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.
Candidate Profile
Strong interest in Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.
Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).
Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.
Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.
Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.
Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.
English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.
Compensation
Per-Video Payment Model: You'll receive compensation for each completed and approved video, with ongoing project opportunities based on performance

description:

Mais do que especialistas em tecnologia, somos uma comunidade de talento e colaboração, onde a confiança e a partilha de conhecimento são a base do nosso crescimento. Aqui, evoluir é um compromisso real, vivido todos os dias.

Rede de parcerias com descontos e benefícios exclusivos em saúde, bem-estar, cultura, viagens, gastronomia, lazer e muito mais.

Team buildings e eventos para descomprimir e celebrar. Há lugares onde o talento faz sentido. Este é um deles!

title: Arquiteto de soluções sap
description:
Oportunidade de Carreira: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP no Grupo LPJ
Sobre o Grupo LPJ:
Com 20 anos de história, o Grupo LPJ é uma holding de consultorias com soluções especializadas em estratégia de negócios, sistemas SAP, gestão de processos, tecnologia e compliance tributário. Formado por empresas com expertise complementar, o grupo é parceiro de grandes marcas e reconhecido por entregar resultados consistentes, com inovação, agilidade e foco em pessoas. Aqui, acreditamos que o nosso maior diferencial está no talento e na dedicação dos nossos times.
As empresas BASE e SOURCE são especialistas em soluções SAP. Juntas, asseguram tanto a implementação quanto a sustentação e otimização de sistemas críticos, garantindo que os clientes tenham segurança, performance e evolução constante. Com forte atuação em tecnologia, gestão de processos e metodologias ágeis, são ambientes ideais para quem busca crescimento técnico e novos desafios em projetos estratégicos.
Sobre o perfil:
Como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, será responsável por compreender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em propostas técnicas e comerciais robustas, viáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da organização. O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.
Responsabilidades Principais:
Entendimento de demanda: Analisar documentos enviados por clientes ou realizar alinhamentos diretos para mapear necessidades técnicas e de negócio;
Desenho de soluções SAP: Modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras) com autonomia, considerando inovação, viabilidade técnica e custo-benefício;
Documentação estratégica: Produzir documentos técnicos completos, mapas de batalha, cronogramas (macro e micro), e artefatos de apoio ao time de delivery, sempre alinhados ao Gerente de Projetos (GP);
Integração interfuncional: Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
Elaboração da proposta final: Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;
Respostas a RFPs: Ser responsável direto pela elaboração de respostas técnicas e comerciais a RFPs (Requests for Proposal), garantindo assertividade, alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente e diferenciação competitiva. Requisitos:
Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras);
Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e Lean IX;
Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio. Diferenciais:
Experiência com clientes enterprise e propostas de alto valor;
Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + Service Now); Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Este consultor deve trabalhar com paixão, foco e propósito, sempre buscando a excelência em suas atividades. Valorizamos a humildade e a ambição de fazer sempre mais e melhor, transformando erros e dificuldades em oportunidades de crescimento e inovação. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, queremos conhecer você!
#Vem Ser LPJ
#Compartilhe

Aqui, acreditamos que o nosso maior diferencial está no talento e na dedicação dos nossos times.
As empresas BASE e SOURCE são especialistas em soluções SAP. Juntas, asseguram tanto a implementação quanto a sustentação e otimização de sistemas críticos, garantindo que os clientes tenham segurança, performance e evolução constante. Com forte atuação em tecnologia, gestão de processos e metodologias ágeis, são ambientes ideais para quem busca crescimento técnico e novos desafios em projetos estratégicos.
Sobre o perfil:
Como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, será responsável por compreender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em propostas técnicas e comerciais robustas, viáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da organização. O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.
Responsabilidades Principais:
Entendimento de demanda: Analisar documentos enviados por clientes ou realizar alinhamentos diretos para mapear necessidades técnicas e de negócio;
Desenho de soluções SAP: Modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras) com autonomia, considerando inovação, viabilidade técnica e custo-benefício;
Documentação estratégica: Produzir documentos técnicos completos, mapas de batalha, cronogramas (macro e micro), e artefatos de apoio ao time de delivery, sempre alinhados ao Gerente de Projetos (GP);
Integração interfuncional: Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
Elaboração da proposta final: Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;
Respostas a RFPs: Ser responsável direto pela elaboração de respostas técnicas e comerciais a RFPs (Requests for Proposal), garantindo assertividade, alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente e diferenciação competitiva. Requisitos:
Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras);
Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e Lean IX;
Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio. Diferenciais:
Experiência com clientes enterprise e propostas de alto valor;
Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + Service Now); Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Este consultor deve trabalhar com paixão, foco e propósito, sempre buscando a excelência em suas atividades. Valorizamos a humildade e a ambição de fazer sempre mais e melhor, transformando erros e dificuldades em oportunidades de crescimento e inovação. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, queremos conhecer você!

title: Representante técnico de vendas
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.
Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.
Atividades:
●Gestão de Relacionamento: Realizar o planejamento estratégico de visitas via CRM, garantindo a execução rigorosa das rotas e o cumprimento das metas de atendimento.
●Expansão de Mercado: Gerir e prospectar carteiras de clientes de forma ativa, identificando novas oportunidades de negócio na região.
●Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: Ministrar treinamentos técnicos e prestar assistência especializada tanto para canais de distribuição quanto para o cliente final.
●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações.
●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca.
Requisitos e qualificações:
●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia.
●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região.
●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal.
●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.
