Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description: Visual & Brand Experience DesignerAbout the Role We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.What You'll Do Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface. Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns. Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership. Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace. Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions. Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity. Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cyclesPreferred Qualifications Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelinesIf you're a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
TheProject Managerin our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are deliveredon time, within scope, and within budget. This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managingmultiple projectsor client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.G.,Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ). Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities. Team Leadership & Coordination:Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site andremote/hybrid work environments. Budget & Risk Management:Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively;
implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.G., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution. Stakeholder Communication:Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Quality Assurance & Delivery:Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs. Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement:Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emergingindustry trends(likeAI integration in project management ,DevSecOps, and newcollaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managingmultiple full project lifecycles, with at least several projects related toIT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. Agile/Other Certs:Additional certifications likeCertified Scrum Master (CSM)orITIL Foundationare beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Multimodalto help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.What You'll Do 1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding. Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching. Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities. Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references. Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions. 3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement. 4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics. Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.Who We're Looking For 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text. Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models. Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.2. Highly valued experience RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks. Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent). Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion. Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems. Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models. Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

This highly selective program is offered inpartnership with leading boutique investment banksin key markets, includingthe US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarterfor this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling Sourcing & Due Diligence Industry and Company Research And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals. Mentorship & Feedback:Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.Who We're Looking For: This program is ideal for highly motivated1st year and 2nd year students(not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who arehungry, quick learners, and committedto excelling in a fast-paced environment.How to Apply: Get your application in now!If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase. This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.2. Content Quality & Accuracy Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose. Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.3. Project Delivery Timeliness Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines. Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken EnglishReady for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Coding Agentsto help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients. This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.What You'll Do: 1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes. Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR). Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works. Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.G., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions. Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals. Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.Who We're Looking For: 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience. Python proficiency required;
proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred. Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss. Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.2. Highly valued experience Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools. Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent). RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design. Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems. Comfort with SQL and structured data workflowsWhy Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

description:

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Finance Manager
description: About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations. Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards. Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready. Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent. Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ. Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners. Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries. Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.Requirements Experience:Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution. Technical Knowledge:Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations. Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines. Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis. Education:Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus. Language Skills:Fluency inEnglish and Portugueseis mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators. Crypto Proficiency:Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (Zos) - Home Office
description:
ITTConnect is seeking aSenior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS)to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).We are seeking an experiencedSenior Mainframe Automation Engineerto lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning fromCA OPS/MVStoIBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OSand fromCA Automation PointtoIBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM). The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position doesnot impact application developmentbut will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.Job responsibilities : Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM. Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments. Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations. Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products. Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes. Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies. Document processes, configurations, and migration steps;
deliver clear communication to stakeholders. Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.Key skills : Mainframe Operations Expertise:Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role. IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS:Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience. TSO and ISPF:Proficient in using these tools for system management. JCL:Strong skills in Job Control Language. REXX Programming:Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts. System Automation Policy Database (PDB):Working knowledge required. Migration Experience:Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects. NetView for z/OS:Experience in implementing and using this product.Preferred Skills and Proficiencies: Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation. Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes. Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance. Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space. Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Finance Manager
description: About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards. Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready. Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent. Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ. Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners. Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries. Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.Requirements Experience:Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution. Technical Knowledge:Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations. Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines. Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis. Education:Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus. Language Skills:Fluency inEnglish and Portugueseis mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators. Crypto Proficiency:Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Senior Api Engineer

Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing). Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards). Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow. Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.Required skills & experience: 7+ years building production microservices and APIs. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design. Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems. Hands-on development inTypeScriptfor backend services. Proven RESTful API design and contract experience. Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies. Strong withAWS(API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents). Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers). Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification. Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties. Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.). Good spoken EnglishNice to have: Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources. Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts). Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics. Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos). Background in personalization/experimentation systems. Hands-on development in Python for backend services.Hiring signals: Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements. Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns. Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems. Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.Perks: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team Health/Sport budget Remote work Flexible PTO Global offices Fun, positive, collaborative environment!Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Ux & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description: UX & Data-Driven Usability DesignerAbout the Role We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.What You'll Do Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment. Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process. Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns. Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains. Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience. Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact. Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences Strong problem-solving and research skills Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelinesPreferred Qualifications Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testingThis role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
Experiência com práticas de integração de sistemas, como ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), SOA (Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços) e iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service);
Proficiência em bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL), bem como em tecnologias de armazenamento e recuperação de dados;

Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;

Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.Buscamos alguém que apresente: Experiencia em gestão de pessoas Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável) Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável) Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dadosAntes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

title: Software Architect
description:

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;
- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;
- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;
- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;
- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.Habilidades Técnicas: - Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);
- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);
- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);
- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.Js, Angular, Next.Js);
- Experiência em .NET edesenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);
- Capacidade de aplicarpadrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);
- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);
- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);
- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);
- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;
- Habilidade em liderardecisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.O que você encontra aqui: Remote First– Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar. Comunidades Técnicas– Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos. Cultura de Feedback– Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI). Gympass- Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo. Reembolso de Equipamentos– Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Garantir a Excelência Operacional e Governança: Monitorar o desempenho e a qualidade dos pipelines, implementando testes automatizados e padrões de governança de dados alinhados às políticas de segurança da informação da empresa.O candidato ideal terá: fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês 3 a 5 anos ou mais de experiência em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines em ambientes corporativos de grande escala. Sólido conhecimento técnico em modelagem de dados, Structured Query Language (SQL) e proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python ou Scala. Capacidade comprovada em processamento de dados distribuídos (ex: Spark) e no uso de plataformas em nuvem para extração e carregamento de conjuntos de dados complexos. Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.O Que Oferecemos (Benefícios) Localização: Opções de trabalho remoto ou híbrido para apoiar o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar: Programa de férias e dias de folga remunerados. Segurança e Futuro: Planos abrangentes de saúde, bem-estar e previdência privada. Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Oportunidades de aprendizado constante e crescimento profissional em uma organização líder global.Pronto para ajudar a proteger e desbloquear o valor da informação? Candidate-se hoje mesmo para integrar nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management e construir as bases de dados do futuro!

title: Social Seller

title: Senior Content Manager
description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youA full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! Note: If you have any more questions or need further assistance for specific arrangements linked to your recruitment process, feel free to contact

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Full Stack Sênior (React/Angular + Java)
description:

Garantir que as decisões técnicas estejam alinhadas à estratégia do produto e aos objetivos de negócio, promovendo qualidade, performance e sustentabilidade das entregas. responsividade e acessibilidade (WCAG). Gerenciamento de Estado: Redux, Context API, Zustand, NgRx ou similares. Vivência com integrações em tempo real (WebSockets). title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities Business Requirements & Client Engagement
- Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
- Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Analista Hubspot

Experiência com GA4, Power BI/Looker, telefonia/WhatsApp e plataformas de mídia.Modelo de contratação: CLT Full + BenefíciosBenefícios TCS – Brasil: Plano de Saúde Planos Odontológico Seguro de Vida Vale Transporte Vale Refeição/Alimentação Auxílio Creche Gympass TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados Parceria com SESC Reembolso de Certificações Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo Oportunidade de experiência internacional Parceria de descontos com Universidades e escolas de idiomas Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuitaOperamos em escala global, com diversas bases de talentos representando 156 nacionalidades, em 55 países. description:

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Multimodalto help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.What You'll Do 1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding. Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching. Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities. Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references. Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions. 3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement. 4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics. Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.Who We're Looking For 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text. Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models. Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.2. Highly valued experience RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks. Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent). Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion. Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems. Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models. Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.Skills & Qualifications:Technical Expertise: Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications. Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components. Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools. Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems. Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.G., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly. Problem-solving Ability: An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly. Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users. Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction. Organizational Skills: Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Preferred Experience:Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role. Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.G., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies. Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS). Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required). Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
